phase.name: phase_1_chat_parity
phase.reason: The physical 19-role Phase-1 pool was repaired to the intended denominator, but current-control semantic acceptance remains unproven. Evaluation has not yet produced checker-v2 execution evidence and the latest evidence-comparator receipt marks all three checker-v2 controls not_assessed.

physical_pool_drift.observation: The platform inventory at run start showed both cross_field and reasoning physically disabled although current repository control keeps both enabled_desired and assigns them Phase-1 work. The pre-action active-task count was 18 including the protected recovery monitor, leaving exactly two slots under the 20-task cap.
physical_pool_drift.reasoning_stop_evidence: automation_control/receipts/reasoning latest commit 582fc9a791ea9ba7a99a2f5a1f683e74b45c56a3 records a bootstrap capability blocker from unavailable SHA-only main-ref lookup; current reasoning config7 and DESIRED_STATE23 provide the exact-blob two-pass fallback and no-self-disable repair.
physical_pool_drift.cross_field_evidence: The latest durable cross_field immutable receipt inspected records scheduler_disable_requested=false. The start-of-run platform inventory nevertheless showed the schedule disabled; no durable receipt inspected authorized that physical stop. Current cross_field config7 already contains the same exact-blob fallback/no-self-disable class of repair. The exact causal path of the later physical disable is therefore not asserted beyond the observed mismatch.
physical_pool_drift.decision: Use the current explicit re-enable-only authorization to re-enable exactly the two intended stopped roles without changing prompts or schedules.

acceptance_still_open.evaluation_observation: Latest durable evaluation receipt 02585c0e4471fe33ebeaf77b0bf0e3830281d154 reports checker_v2_authored=false, checker_v2_executed=false and objective_complete=false after a post-freeze drift stop.
acceptance_still_open.evidence_observation: Latest durable evidence-comparator receipt 06525df6a652b54e4c02263a8fe8bdda732fef7d reports checker-v2 duplicate-negative, low-usefulness-negative and matched-positive statuses all not_assessed and semantic_acceptance_claims=0.
acceptance_still_open.inference: Physical reconciliation removes a topology blocker but cannot close Phase 1. Current-control post-reconciliation role evidence and aggregate checker evidence remain on the critical path.

changes_this_run.target: platform automation Cross Field Frontier Scan

before_after_rationale.before: Repository control required a 19-role Phase-1 proof pool, but only 17 intended roles were physically runnable; cross_field and reasoning were stopped. That directly violated the full-pool Phase-1 policy and prevented 19/19 execution evidence regardless of semantic quality elsewhere.
before_after_rationale.after: Both stopped intended roles returned enabled=true from the physical controller, no other task was disabled/paused/deleted/created, and the inferred total enabled-task count is exactly 20 including the protected recovery monitor. The repository now records the reconciliation and keeps Phase 1 fail-closed pending semantic proof.
before_after_rationale.why_this_reduces_time_to_root: It restores two acceptance-denominator workers concurrently instead of shrinking the denominator or idling their leaves, while preserving the 20-task cap and all protected O boundaries.

method_plan.selected_plan: Do not churn the current 19-role semantic portfolio. Repair the physical denominator only, then collect post-reenable evidence from cross_field/reasoning and finish checker-v2 plus independent evidence-comparator validation under current repository controls.
rejected_alternatives: enable standby work_delegation_gate and exceed capacity
modify prompts or schedules while a re-enable-only repair suffices
claim Phase-1 completion from physical reconciliation alone

rollback.condition: If a re-enabled role immediately reproduces a concrete unrepaired Chat-mode terminal fault, preserve the failure evidence and repair the exact cause in repository control. Do not roll back by disabling the role, shrinking the pool, restoring unrelated base work, enabling standby beyond capacity, or changing protected O authority.

termination.reason: The material physical topology defect was repaired, but Phase-1 semantic/usefulness/conflict/authority acceptance is still incomplete and requires new durable execution evidence.

exact_next_action: Inspect the first post-reenable cross_field and reasoning runs. Require current DESIRED_STATE23/current role-config bootstrap, clean-exploration preservation, durable continuation/evidence, scheduler_disable_requested=false or equivalent recurring persistence, and no fallback to unrelated base work while Phase 1 remains active.

Require evaluation config9 to author checker-v2 only after durable precommit/readback and execute the duplicate-negative, >=20-opportunity low-usefulness-negative, and matched >=0.80 positive controls under exact frozen current authority.
Require evidence_comparator current config14 to independently recompute checker/control identity and aggregate duplicate/conflict/usefulness gates rather than accepting producer summaries.

Reconstruct the complete 19/19 current-role matrix from durable receipts. Phase 1 may close only if every cell and aggregate gate passes; otherwise immediately reassign any completed/blocked capacity within the same Phase-1 root.
